Watch short videos hands-free.

Thumbless plays the next Reel, Short or TikTok by itself — but only after the current one has genuinely finished. No swiping, no timers that cut clips off half way, no jumping ahead. Put your hands down and keep watching.

Works on every feed

YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, Snapchat Spotlight, Reddit, X and Threads work the moment you install it. On any other site with a vertical video feed, open Thumbless from the toolbar and press Turn on here — your browser asks about that one site, and it works there too. No update needed, no waiting for us to add it.

The promise

  • It waits for the video to actually end. Most auto-scrollers run on a timer, or sit on a looping clip forever because the site never says "ended". Thumbless watches the video itself and detects the moment it completes — including on feeds that loop silently.
  • It can't act as you. No code path can like, comment, follow, share, save or message. A policy guard permits exactly one action: moving to the next video — and you can open the log in the popup and read every decision it made.
  • You stay in charge. Two big buttons, ON and OFF. It pauses the instant you touch the screen, scroll, or press a key.
  • Private by design. No account. Nothing leaves your device. Full details in the Privacy Policy, written to match the shipped package line by line.

What you control

Advance after the full video, or at 95% or 90%. A pause before it moves on. Per-feed switches. A sleep timer, an "only while charging" rule for laptops, large controls and reduced motion.

Pricing

Thumbless is a subscription. Every install starts with a 7-day free trial — the complete product, no card, no sign-up. After that it costs from $2.99 a month, with 2, 3, 6 and 12-month terms; 6 and 12 months cost less per month. Checkout opens in an upcoming update; until then the extension shows the prices and keeps your settings.

Get it

Thumbless is published for Chrome. Search for "Thumbless" in the Chrome Web Store, or install it from the listing link once it is live. Edge and Firefox builds follow.
